records.value: Prefers concise, friendly-professional replies. Sign-off: 'Best, Adam'. No corporate filler phrases.
Prefers meetings between 13:00 and 17:00 CET; mornings are kept for focus work.
Dana Reyes — lead integration engineer at Northwind Labs (key client). Technical, appreciates precise numbers. Pricing questions should be routed to Priya Nair.
Marta Lindqvist — Head of Engineering, Adam's manager. Expects direct answers with explicit ETAs.
DataCloud — vendor for data warehouse licenses. Slow to respond; chase after 3 business days.
Acme Pro plan: 1000 requests/min per API key. Temporary burst raises are possible via support ticket; permanent raises and pricing are approved by Product (Priya Nair).
Vendor invoices are paid by finance@acme.io. Forward invoice reminders there with the PO number; do not confirm payment dates yourself.
Snowflake access approvals currently take ~2 weeks; requests are filed via the IT portal.
